name: jellyfin-cc-sync
description: Keeps one Jellyfin user's watched state, favourites and jcc-* tags in line with a jClipCorn database, and writes watches made in Jellyfin back into jClipCorn's viewed history.
overview: Syncs watch state, favourites and tags with a jClipCorn database

versions.changelog: A brief replay of an already watched item no longer counts as a watch: the played-state fallback now needs the stopped playback to have reached the watched threshold, so pausing and finishing later, even in a new session, still counts.

First release: jClipCorn → Jellyfin sync of watched state, favourites and jcc-* tags; Jellyfin watches written back into jClipCorn's viewed history; preview/apply guard, pending queue and full history.
